name: dialogue-memories
description: Turn conversations into stories of experience, creative work, lives, and imagined worlds. Four skills, starting with Memory.

interface.longDescription: Start with Memory: talk about a trip or an everyday moment and grow it into a piece with you at its center. AI narration brings interpretation, metaphor, and creative expression to your material while respecting the experiences you share. Memory is enough for everyday use. Explore Making for the story behind creative work, Legacy for your own life story or the life of someone close to you, or Fiction for stories grown from experience and ideas. Choose another skill when you want to explore a different form.
defaultPrompt: Turn something that happened yesterday into a short piece with me at its center.
I want to preserve a memory from a trip, but where should I start?
Tell my day back to me like a close friend, with a little humor.
